TRAPPING_BUILDER.Title: Universal Trapping Builder
TRAPPING_BUILDER.Description: Describe an item in plain English and the AI will generate a fully functional WFRP4e trapping with effects.
TRAPPING_BUILDER.InputPlaceholder: e.g. "Potion of Bull's Strength: +20 Strength for 3 rounds" or "Enchanted Shield: +10 WS when parrying, adds 1 AP to all locations"
TRAPPING_BUILDER.ApiKeyMissing: Claude API key not configured. Go to Module Settings → Trapping Builder → API Key.
TRAPPING_BUILDER.ApiError: AI generation failed. Check your API key and try again.
